insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
Chronic Renal Failure or end stage Renal Failure
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Critical Illness initial waiting period 90 days. Personal/special waiting period up to 36 months may be applied to declared pre-existing conditions.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity up to Sum Insured per policy year
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes Medical Practitioner fees, diagnostics, medicines, OT, ICU, IV, blood, prosthetics implanted internally.

day_care_treatments.notes: Less than 24 hours due to technological advancement.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: When patient cannot be moved or hospital bed unavailable; 3-day minimum continuous treatment.

ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy inpatient treatment

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to 2 deliveries with sub-limits based on SI tier (Elite Plan only)
maternity_coverage.notes: 3-year waiting period. Both husband and wife must be covered.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: 25% of Sum Insured from day 1 (Elite Plan)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for organ harvesting expenses

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.3,000 Classic / Rs.5,000 Supreme / Rs.10,000 Elite per hospitalization

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Covers 11 standard critical illnesses (Cancer, Heart Attack, CABG, Heart Valve Replacement, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Permanent Paralysis, Motor Neuron Disease, Multiple Sclerosis)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Up to 22 CIs available with Supreme Plus / Elite Plus add-ons.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Re-load up to 100% of Base Sum Insured
restoration_benefit.notes: Different illness or different insured for same illness. Not for first claim.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Over and above Base Sum Insured.

copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment on admissible claims for International Treatment abroad for specified CI under Elite. Zone 2 priced at 25% discount.

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Elite Plan: 50% of SI up to Rs.20 lakhs; USD 2,000 deductible
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Excludes US and Canada (option to include via Endorsement 3 at additional premium).

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas
temporary_exclusions: Pre-existing diseases 36 months (Excl01) - 24 months for Elite
Bariatric Surgery 72 months (Supreme Plus)/48 months (Elite Plus)
Personal waiting period up to 36 months for declared PED
notable_exclusions_summary: Lifeline policy wording excludes congenital external anomalies, infertility (without rider), refractive error, all OPD treatment, treatments outside India (except specified emergency/CI international cover under Elite), and cosmetic/plastic surgery. Personal waiting periods up to 36 months may be applied based on health declaration.
claim_process_summary: Claims settled through TPA. Cashless: pre-authorization via TPA helpline at network hospitals. Reimbursement: submit documents within stipulated timeline. Settlement within 15 days of last necessary document. Penal interest at 2% above bank rate for delays.
available_riders: Elite Plus optional cover (IVF + 22 CI Second Opinion + 14 CI International Treatment)
